q: How many times longer is a cheek cell than a red blood cell?
Which cells are plant cells? Use two columns to explain.
Onion and palisade cells: they have a cell wall; the palisade cell also has chloroplasts. (The bacterium has a wall but is not a plant.)
Explain why the onion cell has no chloroplasts though it is a plant cell.
It grows underground in the bulb, with no light: chloroplasts would be no use for photosynthesis there.
